title: Healing Arts One-Time Workshop
location: Pence Gallery, 212 D Street, Davis, CA 95616
description:
Healing Arts One-Time Workshop in Davis 
Monday, October 26, 10-11:45 AM 
$5 Members, $10 Non-Members (all materials included) 
  
Part of the Pence’s Healing Arts Program and run by facilitator Amy Vidra, this one-time workshop focuses more broadly on themes related to depression, anxiety, or major life changes. Through the process of art making, participants will have opportunities for discussion, education, and connecting with peers in a safe and supportive space. 
  
Registration is required in advance through our website, and space is limited to the first 8 participants who register. Participants must be 18 or older, and no art experience is necessary. This program is generously sponsored by Bob & Joanne Andresen. 
  
Register here (REQUIRED): https://pencegallery.org/education/programs/workshops-and-classes/ 
  
If you register for this session and are unable to attend, please let us know in advance. 
  
Any questions? Email pencegallery@gmail.com.

title: Conscious Conversations & Somatic Practices
description:
Iama Embodied Community
This is a spiritual community that honors the body’s wisdom and lived experience. Whether you’re healing from religious trauma, deconstructing beliefs, exploring spirituality, or just want to be with other conscious persons, this space is for you.

Expect conscious conversations, meditation, breathwork, sound healing, and other somatic practices to help reconnect with ourselves and each other.

title: Renegade Orchestra at Davis Odd Fellows
location: Davis Odd Fellows Hall, 415 2nd Street, Davis, 95616, United States
description:
Renegade Orchestra in Davis – The Beauty of a Symphony, the Soul of a Rock Band 
The Renegade Orchestra is the bay area’s most rock and roll symphony. Is it a rock band? Is it an orchestra? Who knows? But it’s definitely the best of both worlds. The pure unbridled fury of some of the bay area’s top orchestra players unleashed on classic rock songs backed up by a hard-hitting rhythm section. 
The Renegade Orchestra will be performing at Davis Odd Fellows, which is located right in downtown, and is a comfortable and casual hall with great views of the stage. The Renegade Orchestra will rock out to classic songs from Hendrix to Metallica and from Bowie to Zeppelin. 
At this show, the Renegade Orchestra will present a comfortable, but lively show featuring around top bay area string players combined with a driving rhythm section, all committed to having a relaxed and rocking time. If there is something you hate about orchestra concerts, this is the opposite. 
“Classical Rebels.” The Bohemian 
“The Renegade Orchestra would rather tackle Hendrix than Handel.” Mercury News 
  
Renegade Orchestra at Davis Odd Fellows 
415 2nd Street 
Davis, CA 95616 
Oct 16 at 7 pm 
Tickets: $25 at RenegadeOrchestra.com

title: Gentle yoga
description:
Iama Embodied Community

title: Portraits of Things: Paintings by Gioia Fonda and Charlie Gill
location: Pence Gallery, 212 D Street, Davis, CA 95616
description:
Portraits of Things: Paintings by Gioia Fonda and Charlie Gill at Pence Gallery in Davis 
Exhibit: October 9 – November 29, 2026 
Reception: Friday, October 9, 6-9 PM (Free) 
Artist Talk: Sunday, November 8, 2-3:30 PM (Free) 
  
Interdisciplinary artist Gioia Fonda has long collected colorful toys, both for their intrinsic charm and as creative inspiration. As a student at California College of the Arts, she arranged small collectibles into still-life compositions, captured them on film, and processed the photos at a local drugstore. Captivated by these arrangements, her advisor, Charlie Gill, painted spare compositions based on her photographs—works that now hang alongside hers. For this exhibition, Fonda has created a series of new paintings featuring similar arrangements of toys and found objects. She is also offering an opportunity for members of the public to exhibit their own small works on paper, riffing on some of her recent photos. Artists may add to this display throughout the duration of the show.  
  
Sponsored by the Pence Community Curatorial Fund. 
  
Image: Gioia Fonda, “Holding It Together”

title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note
description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering
Update 8/14/25:
**We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)

We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.

People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.

Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.

You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants and businesses.
source: Meetup Yolo County Board Game Gathering

title: Figure Drawing Group
location: Pence Gallery, 212 D Street, Davis, CA 95616
description:
Figure Drawing Group in Davis 
Wednesday, October 28, 6:30-9 PM 
$15 Members, $22 Non-Members | Limited to 10 participants 
Registration & payment is required in advance through the Pence’s website. 
  
We hold self-guided figure drawing sessions with a nude model every 2nd & 4th Wednesday of the month, from 6:30–9 PM. This group is for both experienced artists and amateurs to have an opportunity to draw from the nude model. If you have never drawn from a live model before and would like to join us, you are very welcome! People of all skill levels, ages 18 and up, are welcome and encouraged to join. 
  
This is not a class, and no instruction is provided. The atmosphere is relaxed and non-competitive. Bring your own art materials, and we’ll provide a comfortable place to sketch or paint live models in our upstairs classroom space. Participants will work independently through a warm up with shorter poses and longer, twenty-minute poses. A staff member will be on-site to facilitate the group and to answer questions. 
  
Register here: https://pencegallery.org/education/programs/figure-drawing/ 
  
Questions? Email Yuuki at pencegalleryassociate@gmail.com. 
  
Image: drawing by Deziree Seidner

title: Tim McNary Live @ The Melon Ball
location: The Melon Ball – Watermelon Music, 1970 Lake Blvd., Davis, CA, 95616, United States
description:
Tim McNary Live @ The Melon Ball in Davis 
Tim McNary is a Cinematic Folk Artist from the Southern United States. He found his passion for songwriting while backpacking throughout South America after college. The Nashville based songwriter traverses emotional and geographical borders with multi-dimensional songwriting and evocative  vocals. Some of his musical influences include Ben Howard, Foy Vance, & Leif Vollebekk. He’s had dozens of  film & tv placements, collaborated with a host of recognized songwriters, and toured extensively around the United States & Canada. 
Listen to Tim on Spotify or Soundcloud
Live Performance Snippets (YouTube)
Back to the Beginning (Live – YouTube)

title: SSRI R&B Jazz Quintet Live @ The Melon Ball
location: The Melon Ball – Watermelon Music, 1970 Lake Blvd., Davis, CA, 95616, United States
description:
Live Music @ The Melon Ball in Davis 
SSRI is a modern jazz collective that is deeply influenced by artists and groups such as: Robert Glasper, Roy Hargrove, and Lettuce. They perform a diverse repertoire of original contemporary jazz arrangements, standards from The American Song Book, and covers of beloved R&B songs from the 90s and mid 2000s. Each band member has a different musical background, but we’ve drawn together due to our shared love of Jazz, R&B, Gospel and Pop music. Join us as we celebrate the music of Michael Jackson, Luther Vandross, Stevie Wonder, and more! 
$20 General Admission
$15 Seniors/Students
$10 Kids under 12 
Doors open at 7:00pm
Cash or Venmo at the door only (no Credit Card) 
This is a BYOB event!

title: Davis Farmers Market
location: Central Park, 301 C Street, Davis, CA, 95616, United States
description:
Year-round at Central Park in downtown Davis, thousands gather each week to shop for what is grown, raised, and made locally at our markets. We are dedicated to bringing farmers right to your table, so we stay open rain or shine. 
Walk rows of stalls lined with an array of fruits and vegetables, including certified organic produce, choice meats, chicken, seafood, wine, local eggs and honey. Choose from a variety of fresh-baked goods, plants, flowers and gifts. Enjoy a picnic from one of our many food stands, made from market ingredients.

title: Portraits of Things: Paintings by Gioia Fonda and Charlie Gill
location: Pence Gallery, 212 D Street, Davis, CA 95616
description:
Portraits of Things: Paintings by Gioia Fonda and Charlie Gill at Pence Gallery in Davis 
Exhibit: October 9 – November 29, 2026 
Reception: Friday, October 9, 6-9 PM (Free) 
Artist Talk: Sunday, November 8, 2-3:30 PM (Free) 
  
Interdisciplinary artist Gioia Fonda has long collected colorful toys, both for their intrinsic charm and as creative inspiration. As a student at California College of the Arts, she arranged small collectibles into still-life compositions, captured them on film, and processed the photos at a local drugstore. Captivated by these arrangements, her advisor, Charlie Gill, painted spare compositions based on her photographs—works that now hang alongside hers. For this exhibition, Fonda has created a series of new paintings featuring similar arrangements of toys and found objects. She is also offering an opportunity for members of the public to exhibit their own small works on paper, riffing on some of her recent photos. Artists may add to this display throughout the duration of the show.  
  
Sponsored by the Pence Community Curatorial Fund. 
  
Image: Gioia Fonda, “Holding It Together”

title: Let's talk about Female Sexuality & Fluidity
description:
Iama Embodied Community
If you have ever questioned your sexuality, experienced unexpected attraction, fallen for someone who challenged how you understood your sexual identity, or simply wondered why we don’t talk more openly about women’s sexuality, this event is for you.

I thought I was heterosexual until I fell in love with a woman. Reading Sexual Fluidity by Lisa Diamond has helped me make sense of my experience, and it made me realize how many women might be navigating similar questions without having a safe space to talk about them.

Come join us in a frank, open conversation and connect with other women with similar experiences. Let's talk about sexual fluidity and unexpected attraction, questioning or rethinking the labels we’ve used to understand ourselves, dating patterns, desire, and the ways our experiences of attraction may change, sexual shame, social expectations, and the messages we’ve inherited about sexuality, gender, identity, and giving ourselves permission to explore without needing all the answers (and labels), what else is on YOUR mind??

We’ll meet at Betty on T, they have coffee, tea, wine, and food options. Depending on our group size and the weather we’ll find a spot indoors or on the heated patio. I’ll have a sign on our table. Please RSVP to help with the reservation.

If you know a woman who might appreciate this kind of space, please share the event with her. You never know who might be looking for this conversation.

**About the hostess**

I’m Rola (pronounced Ru-lah), I am a pastor, yoga instructor, somatic guide, and trauma-informed facilitator currently working toward becoming a somatic coach. I bring experience in group facilitation, integrative somatic trauma therapy, embodiment, and a deep curiosity about the ways we experience ourselves and relate to one another.

**P.S.**

* This isn’t a formal workshop or a lecture. I’ll bring a few prompts to get the conversation started, but my hope is that it unfolds organically, shaped who shows up and what we feel moved to share
* There is no pressure to disclose anything personal, you are welcome to share, ask questions, or simply listen or be present
* You don’t need to be questioning your sexuality or have a particular identity to join. Even if you’re just curious about female sexuality and how it unfolds, you are welcome
* This space is for female-bodied individuals

title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note
description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering
Update 8/14/25:
**We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)

We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.

People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.

Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.

You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants and businesses.

title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note
description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering
Update 8/14/25:
**We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)

We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.

People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.

Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.

You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants and businesses.
source: Meetup Yolo County Board Game Gathering

title: Blood on the Clocktower at Blue Note
description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering
The first Wednesday of every month, we play _Blood on the Clocktower_, a social deduction game in the vein of Werewolf/Mafia/The Resistance, with a few twists!

We'll have a circle of chairs reserved inside Blue Note, near the back, with a Yolo County Board Game Gathering sign on the table. Just say hello, and we'll show you some games, pull some players together, and get to having fun!

We also usually have a few tables of players playing other board games, if social deduction isn't your bag!

Get a feel for Blood on the Clocktower here: https://youtu.be/4sfa8_kNxsQ
source: Meetup Yolo County Board Game Gathering
